about: A free-form made wall against the game's tiles (F-146, EXP-90 check 1): where the lines between tiles' centres cross it (grid_crossings), the tiles it stands over and so takes (row_tiles: its solid meets the box round a tile's centre 40 wide, 60 to 92 up, where the game looks for room to stand), and what the game does at each opening (opening_play). tools/editor/made_edits.py (test_compiler_free.py) and web/walls.js gridCrossings, rowTiles and openingPlay (shared_cases_test.mjs) both pass them. `origin` is the map's grid corner the compiler reads them from (tileGrid.origin).

cases.case: EXP-90's wall A, its line 7.5 off the row's centre line y -1104: it stands over the row's three tiles; its window's tile is taken (the wall under the window fills the tile's middle from 60 to 72), no climb; its doorway's tile is free, walked through
the same wall on the tile edge y -1152: crossings at the tiles' centre lines, none stood over; the window is climbed through, the doorway walked (an edge wall's reading)
along y on a tile edge (yaw 16384) from a tile corner: a doorway and a window, an edge wall's reading
along y inside a column of tiles, 30 off its centre line: its faces 22 to 38 off it, short of the tile's middle (20): stands over none
along y, 25 off a column's centre line: its faces 17 to 33 off it reach the tile's middle: it stands over the column's tiles; its doorway (96 wide, to 160) leaves its tile free
on a row's centre line, a doorway 30 wide round a tile's centre: the wall beside it fills the tile's middle (40 wide), so its tile is taken: no one walks through
on a row's centre line, a doorway whose top (80) is under the tile's middle's top (92): its tile is taken
a low wall (to 50) on a row's centre line: under the tile's middle (60 to 92), it stands over none

at 30 degrees (yaw 5461) from a tile corner: it crosses both families of lines; where its crossing with a line is within reach of a tile's centre on it, it stands over that tile: its window over one is taken (no climb), its doorway at a crossing between tiles is walked
